## 2026-09-15 — response-parsing + enemy-stats-conditions (Lap 2: robustness against hostile input)

`npm test`: 2549 passing / 141 files (green; the hosted container shipped without `node_modules` again — `npm install` first).

Rotation: the last-6 union (origin == HEAD after fetch) excludes rules-math, quests (09-14), spellcasting, chronicler (09-13), character-vault, inventory-economy (09-12), combat-exchange, persistence (09-11), roll-resolution, cloud-sync (09-10), dice-engine, scene-art (09-09). **response-parsing** + **enemy-stats-conditions** tie oldest at 09-05 (both Lap 1 only); this is their Lap 2. Lens: what the wire still admits past `normalizeEvents`, and what a hostile save carries past `sanitizeLoadedEnemy`. Every finding below was **reproduced empirically** against the live parser, `normalizeEvents`, `applyEvents`, the reducer (`SET_LOCATION`, `USE_RESOURCE`, `LOAD_GAME`, `UPDATE_ENEMY`), and `buildSystemPrompt` with a throwaway vitest file (deleted, never committed; zero repo changes). Coverage snapshot is five days old — not refreshed. **All eleven 09-05 findings verified fixed in code** (pre-fence narrative on repair failure, trailing prose, `/i` + bare fence, quoted-key anchor, dc coercion, the hero-condition normalizer at all three boundaries, `rollEnemySave` honoring conditions, `toNumber` ahead of the enemy validators, the `canonicalEnemyId` direct suite).

### response-parsing (`llm/responseParser.js`, `llm/utils/jsonExtractor.js`, `llm/eventChannels.js` end to end, plus each channel's first consumer — `applyEvents.js`, `SET_LOCATION`, `USE_RESOURCE`, `UPDATE_STORY_MEMORY`, `ADD_WORLD_FACTS`, `findInventoryItemByRef`) — Lap 2
- **Scope examined:** every registry `read` against object / array / numeric-string / oversized values; the fence and anchor paths against braces and fences inside string values; `repairJson` on truncations; perf on a 234k response. **Verified sound:** `guardedList` everywhere it is used; `requested_rolls` (dc/description/skill/notation; a `modifier: 40` is rejected downstream by `validateEnemyAttackBonus`; a `99d100+50` damage_roll is display-only); `world_facts` object `fact` dropped + 400-char clamp in the reducer; `memory_updates` junk fully rejected by `normalizeStoryMemoryUpdate` (id/status/salience); `equipment_changes` object refs never throw; the 09-05 quoted-key anchor (a prose mention before the block) and an earlier complete object before the block both parse; a fence with no closer repairs cleanly.
- **Findings:**
  - **P1 — the `location` wire is the DM's door into the Scribe's private registry lane.** `raw.location || null` passes any object, and `SET_LOCATION` honors an object payload's `profile` and `fillOnly` — the shape only `scribe.js` and the journal cadence were meant to send. Reproduced: `location: { name: "The Old Mill", profile: { type: "hostile_site", danger: "deadly", region: "Ashen Reach", theaterFrontIds: ["front-1"] } }` lands ALL FOUR on the record (whitelisted values, but accepted). A theater claim is the world-tempo gate — it unlocks that front's full-intensity symptoms wherever the DM says (the 2026-07-14 "theaters grow organically" rule), a `region` while the hero is there one-shot-triggers regional front seeding, and `fillOnly: true` makes a real relocation a no-op. Living-world rule since 08-05: "no new DM event channels" — this one existed by omission. The likely real form is milder (an object with `name` + descriptive keys); the hostile form is the finding.
  - **P1 — `resources_used` has no valid payload, so its only reachable outcome is a false statement to the player.** The prompt forbids the channel for every class resource, applyEvents skips the four real keys as UI-owned, and everything else reaches `USE_RESOURCE`, whose unknown-key branch posts "**X unavailable** — it has already been used and must be recharged by rest." Reproduced: `["Second Wind"]` (display casing, the most ordinary drift) tells the player their fresh Second Wind is spent; an object element posts "**[object Object] unavailable**"; a 3,000-char string posts a 3,000-char line; the cap allows ten per response.
  - **P2 — live `currentLocation` is unclamped** (`npcs.js:327`): a 100k location → 100k `currentLocation`, no record minted (the registry clamps at 120), and a 163,785-char prompt (over the 160k budget) every turn until the next location event. LOAD_GAME clamps it at 200 and the save row at `META_TEXT_MAX` — the 09-14 twin rule INVERTED: a load clamp with no live-write twin.
  - **P2 — the extractor is string-aware forwards, not backwards.** An unbalanced `{` inside a string value before the anchor key (`"location": "Gate {West", "quest_updates": …`) anchors inside the string; parse and repair fail; the raw JSON ships as narrative (unfenced path only — DM disobedience squared). Sibling on the fenced path: the lazy fence regex stops at a ``` inside a JSON string — `"Read the ``` sign"` minted quest "Read the" AND appended `sign", "status": "new"}]}` to the story as prose. Balanced braces in a string, a prose `}` before the block, and 300k unfenced objects are fine.
  - **P2 — "[object Object]" pass-throughs:** `player_death.description` (object → `**[object Object]**` system line; 50k chars unclamped), `starting_items.name` (an item literally named "[object Object]" minted into the pack; 5,000 chars unclamped), `spell_cast.spell` (visible "unknown spell" line); `requested_rolls.modifier` is number-only, so `"+4"` — how every statblock writes it — is null → default (the numeric-string parity the 09-05 enemy fix landed one file over).
  - **P2 — two dead channels still cost prompt tokens.** `enemy_updates` can never act: applyEvents drops all events in active combat and `combat.enemies` is `[]` outside it (reproduced: `UPDATE_ENEMY` no-op) — rollResolver's flush reads the same empty list — yet `promptBuilder.js:499` still routes fodder there. `resources_used` is the other (above). Lap-4 note filed now because the junk branch is the ONLY reachable one.
  - **P2 belts:** `parseResponse(123)` throws (`response.match`); `repairJson` on a truncation ending in `\` appends an escaped quote and stays unparseable; each prose anchor mention walks back to index 0 — 4,000 mentions in a 234k reply = 1.56 s on the main thread (a real ≤5k reply is fine; `detectTextRollRequests` on 200k = 7 ms).
  - **Test depth:** none of the reproduced shapes is pinned; `USE_RESOURCE` has no reducer test for an unknown key at all.
- **Suggested improvements:** (1) type `location` string-or-null (fold `{ name }` to its name, drop the rest); (2) `resources_used` strings-only + must be a `CLASSES[class].resources` key, or retire the channel with `enemy_updates` (registry + RESPONSE_FORMAT + applyEvents, agreement-tested); (3) `LOCATION_NAME_MAX` at the SET_LOCATION write; (4) string state on the backward walk, last-closing-fence (or balanced body) on the fence regex; (5) string-or-drop + clamps on the four pass-throughs, `toFiniteNumber` on `modifier`; (6) the pins.

### enemy-stats-conditions (`engine/enemyStats.js` end to end; `validateCombatStart`; `normalizeCombatEnemy`/`START_COMBAT`/`UPDATE_ENEMY`; the three exchange condition lanes — `normalizeConditionDelta`, `on_success`, enemy-intent `remove_conditions` — and `applyEnemyConditionDelta`; `rollEnemySave`; `sanitizeLoadedEnemy` through `LOAD_GAME` and into `buildSystemPrompt`; the hero twin at all three boundaries) — Lap 2
- **Scope examined:** numeric-string / scalar / object / case-drift shapes on the wire, in the exchange envelope, and on a loaded save. **Verified sound:** `toNumber` coercion (`"59"`, `"+6"`, `"15/20"` → 15, `"1e3"` → 999 cap); `normalizeEnemyConditions` on null / nested-array / number / object elements; all three exchange condition lanes (scalar accepted, junk dropped, deduped, capped at 30); `rollEnemySave` honors conditions; `sanitizeLoadedEnemy`'s whitelist projection; hero `conditions` typed at parser, handlers, and load.
- **Findings:**
  - **P1 — a trailing damage TYPE rejects the whole notation to the 1d6 default.** `sanitizeEnemyDamage` requires `^NdM(±K)$` after whitespace removal, so `"1d8+2 slashing"`, `"2d8+4 bludgeoning"`, `"1d8 + 2 (slashing)"` → `undefined` → `DEFAULT_ENEMY_DAMAGE` (1d6), silently, for the whole fight. Reproduced: an ogre declared at `2d8+4 bludgeoning` swings for 1d6. `boundCompanionDamage` strips exactly these suffixes since 09-09; the enemy lane — the one that decides every fight's danger — never got the twin, and the failure has no visible note (the offensive-REJECT policy is right for `+99`; a type word is not a hallucination).
  - **P2 — the combat check slot's `dc` is `Number.isFinite`-gated** (`combatExchange.js:143`): `"dc": "15"` is DC 10 (reproduced) while `slot_level` coerces ten lines below (09-13) and the out-of-combat lane coerces since 09-05.
  - **P2 — `validateCombatStart` parity nits:** `conditions: "prone"` (scalar) → `[]` while `normalizeConditionDelta` accepts a scalar; `is_undead: "true"` is strict-false (`toFlag` exists; undeadness gates Turn Undead — keep `boss` strict by policy); `hp: 0` / `true` → a fresh 20-HP foe.
  - **P2 — load boundary:** an object `name`/`id` loads as **"[object Object]"** on the enemy card AND in the combat prompt (`**[object Object]** (id: [object Object])`, reproduced; a second such foe re-mints to `enemy-object-object`); `isUndead: "false"` → true (`!!`); `combatStatus: "FLED"` → active (case-sensitive whitelist). No crash, no deadlock — the 09-11 typed envelope holds.
  - **Test depth:** no damage-type-suffix case, no string-`dc` exchange case, no object-name/string-`isUndead` load case, no `enemy_updates` reachability pin (all existing hits assume a populated `combat.enemies`).
- **Suggested improvements:** (1) strip a trailing type suffix before the notation match and log the coercion (multi-part and count-less notations may keep rejecting); (2) `toFiniteNumber` on the slot `dc`; (3) scalar-to-list + `toFlag(is_undead)` at combat_start; (4) `cleanTextField`-style name/id and `toFlag` in `sanitizeLoadedEnemy`, case-fold `combatStatus`; (5) the pins.

### Process notes
- Queue had ZERO open items at run start (the 09-14 sweep cleared it); thirteen lines added (3 P1). Coverage snapshot not refreshed (5 days).
- **New Lap-2 sub-pattern: a channel with no valid payload is not harmless — its junk branch is the only reachable one.** `resources_used` is forbidden for every real key and `enemy_updates` has no reducer that can act, so every entry a drifting DM emits lands on the error/no-op branch. Rule for the lens: for each registry entry, name the ONE live reducer effect; none → retire the channel (and its RESPONSE_FORMAT line, a per-turn token cost) rather than harden it, and an agreement test can assert it.
- **Second: the 09-14 twin rule has an inverse.** A LOAD clamp with no live-write twin (`currentLocation` 200 at load, bare on `SET_LOCATION`) is the same class as a parser whitelist with no load twin — grep both directions.
- **Third: a `raw.x || null` read is a shape leak.** `location` is the last registry entry whose `read` passes an untyped object through, and the reducer behind it accepts a privileged shape from a different sender. Every channel whose reducer distinguishes senders by payload SHAPE needs the wire typed to the DM's shape only.

## 2026-09-14 — rules-math + quests (Lap 2: robustness against hostile input)

`npm test`: 2518 passing / 137 files (green; the hosted container shipped without `node_modules` again — `npm install` first).

Rotation: the last-6 union (origin == HEAD after fetch) excludes spellcasting, chronicler (09-13), character-vault, inventory-economy (09-12), combat-exchange, persistence (09-11), roll-resolution, cloud-sync (09-10), dice-engine, scene-art (09-09), hidden-fronts, living-world (09-08). **rules-math** + **quests** tie oldest at 09-04 (both Lap 1 only); this is their Lap 2. Lens: what a hand-edited / cloud-round-tripped / pre-fix save can carry into `rules.js`'s reads and into the quest rows, and what the wire still admits. Every finding below was **reproduced empirically** against the live reducer (`LOAD_GAME`), `buildSystemPrompt`, and the rules exports with a throwaway vitest file (deleted, never committed; zero repo changes). Coverage snapshot is four days old — not refreshed.

### rules-math (`engine/rules.js` end to end, its load twin `healLoadedCharacter`/`backfillCharacterShape` in `migrations.js`, the proficiency-array consumers — `getSkillModifier` via the resolver, `getAllSkills` via the sheet, `getSavingThrowModifier`, the prompt's character block — and `computeACFromInventory`'s two callers: the load AC recompute and the exchange's `playerAc`) — Lap 2
- **Scope examined:** every export against non-string, non-array, numeric-string, and object inputs; the two item-bonus trust boundaries; the class key through `CLASSES[…]`. **Verified fixed since 09-04:** weapon-bonus coercion + floors + the corrected `:39` comment; `getAllSkills` folded onto `getSkillModifier`; thrown-weapon and junk-`damageBonus` pins — all in code and tested. **Verified sound:** every item-bonus read is coerced, floored, and capped (`clampItemBonus`); junk `baseAC`/`shieldAC` degrade to unarmored / the plain +2; `abilityScores`, `level`, `conditions`, `deathSaves` are typed at load; `CLASSES[character.class]` is safe because `healUnknownClassRace` whitelists the class FIRST; a string `conditions` iterates harmlessly; and **`fightingStyle` is re-normalized on EVERY load** (`backfillCharacterShape` → `normalizeFightingStyle`): `"DEFENSE"`, `{}`, and a missing style all store `defense`, engine AC (17 in chain mail) and the prompt label agree — hunted because the engine compares the raw key, recorded so it isn't hunted again.
- **Findings:**
  - **P1 — the three proficiency lists are the untyped shelf of the hero.** `backfillCharacterShape` defaults only a MISSING `skillProficiencies`/`expertiseSkills` (the `...character` spread after the defaults means a present-but-junk value always wins), `savingThrowProficiencies` has no default at all, `healLoadedCharacter` never touches any of them, and the vault's 09-03 skill clamp covers hero FILES only. Reproduced through `LOAD_GAME`: a number / boolean / object value loads intact and `?.includes is not a function` throws out of `getSkillModifier` (every out-of-combat skill roll), `getAllSkills` (the Character Sheet boundary), `getSavingThrowModifier`, AND `buildSystemPrompt` (`promptBuilder.js:660`) — every turn fails, the campaign is unplayable, and the sheet that would show the damage is the other thing that dies. A STRING value is the sneaky twin: `"stealth and perception"` → `String.prototype.includes` → substring proficiency (stealth +5 instead of +3, reproduced) while the prompt throws on `.join` (`:684`). Optional chaining is a null guard, not a type guard — the 09-13 class-gated-heal family, one field over.
  - **P1 — a non-caster's `sustainedSpell` reaches the AC read bare** (the AC face of the open 09-13 spellcasting P1, which names the strip; this is the read-site belt). `computeACFromInventory` reads `sustainedSpell?.acBonus || 0` uncoerced. Reproduced: a Fighter with `{ key: "mage_armor", acBonus: "5" }` → `armorClass` **`"115"` — a STRING** — stamped at load (`migrations.js:428`) AND returned live by the exchange's `playerAc` (`combatExchange.js:1362`), so every enemy `total >= "115"` misses: an unhittable hero, persisted into the next save; `{ acBonus: 9 }` with no key → a permanent AC-20 fighter. The wizard twin rebuilds to `null`. The 08-28 `baseAC` lesson ("Number() first") stopped one line short.
  - **P2 nits:** `getWeaponAbilityModifier` reads `character.abilityScores.strength` without the `?.` its siblings use (belt — the heal guarantees the object); `getProficiencyBonus(NaN)` returns **+6** (every `<=` is false) — no caller passes an untyped level today, but a future companion-side caller would get max proficiency for free.
  - **Test depth:** `rules.test.js:145` covers UNDEFINED proficiency arrays only; no test feeds a non-array value, no load test carries one, and no AC test loads a non-caster with a `sustainedSpell`.
- **Suggested improvements:** (1) type the three lists in `healLoadedCharacter` — array-filter to `SKILL_ABILITIES` keys / `ABILITY_NAMES`, deduped and capped (the vault's `sanitizeCharacter` clamp is the model; expertise ⊆ proficiencies for rogues only); (2) `clampItemBonus`-style coercion on `acBonus` at the read site regardless of the heal; (3) `?.` on `abilityScores`; (4) the pins.

### quests (the `quest_updates` wire — `normalizeQuestUpdate`/`guardedList`, the applyEvents loop, `handlers/quests.js` whole, the load boundary in `validateSaveState`, `QuestPanel.jsx`, `buildQuestBlock`, the save-metadata `questCount`) — Lap 2
- **Scope examined:** hostile wire shapes, hostile save rows, and the XP lanes under both. **Verified fixed since 09-04:** bare-id completion pays 0, the never-tracked insert pays 0, `maxLength` + the handler clamp — all in code and pinned. **Verified sound on the wire:** id string-or-number → string ≤80, name ≤160, description ≤800, status aliases → whitelist → `new`, cap 8, nameless-and-idless / object-named entries dropped; `ADD_QUEST` picks fields explicitly (status/`addedAt`/`openedAtMessage` junk cannot ride in); fuzzy identity unambiguous-only; the same-turn gate and the pre-age clamp hold.
- **Findings:**
  - **P1 — quest rows are untyped at LOAD.** `validateSaveState` keeps any object (`session.js:281-283`) and types no field — the 07-25 parser whitelist never got its load twin. Reproduced: `name: { evil: true }` survives, renders **"[object Object]"** as the quest's name in the DM prompt every turn, and reaches `<span>{quest.name}</span>` as a React child, so the Quests `ErrorBoundary` trips on every open — and the ✕ that would remove the row lives inside the dead panel (unrecoverable from the UI). `description` has the same shape.
  - **P2 — the rest of the row is untyped too:** a 200,000-char name loads intact and rides the prompt in full (a 262,884-char prompt against the 160k budget — the 09-04 clamp landed on the WRITE paths and `buildQuestBlock` clamps descriptions at 250, names never); `status: "ACTIVE"` is invisible to the panel and the prompt (both `=== 'active'`) AND to `ADD_QUEST`'s active-only dedupe, so the DM re-opening it mints a second row (reproduced: 2); an id-less row cannot be completed from the panel (✓ sends `undefined` → no-op) while ✕ on it removes EVERY id-less row; duplicate ids close together on a DM completion (pays once — fine, noted).
  - **P2 (ruling — flag, not reverse) — the same-response instant tier compounds through the wire cap.** 4 `new`+`completed` pairs in one response = **100 XP at L1** (reproduced) vs 38 for a real tracked completion a turn later; a level in three responses from a DM that opens-and-closes errands. Bounded by the cap (≤100/response) and by design there is no cross-message ledger (the terminal row is the guard; each errand name is new). The 2026-08-26 ruling set `QUEST_INSTANT_XP` flat at 25 — at L1 that is two-thirds of a real quest. Revisit explicitly: scale it to a fraction of the level tier, or pay the instant tier once per response.
  - **Test depth:** the load suite carries only a `null` quest row; no object name / bad status / id-less / duplicate-id / oversized name pins; no multi-pair same-response XP pin.
- **Suggested improvements:** (1) a `sanitizeQuestRecord` at load — id string-or-mint, name through `clampQuestText` or drop the row, description clamp, status lowercased + whitelisted, `openedAtMessage` `toInt`; (2) a name clamp in `buildQuestBlock` as the belt; (3) the instant-tier revisit; (4) the pins.

- **Findings:**
  - **P1 — a non-caster's `spellSlots` is untyped at load and CombatPanel gates on truthiness, not class.** `healLoadedCharacter` types `spellSlots`/`sustainedSpell` only for casters; a Fighter's raw value rides `...character`. The sheet, the prompt block, and the rest lane all gate on `isSpellcaster`; `CombatPanel.jsx:37` does not. Reproduced: `spellSlots: { 1: null }` → `summarizeSpellSlots` throws on `null.max` — the Combat panel's boundary on every fight; `'junk'` → "L0 NaN/undefined · …" in the header. The `healUnknownClassRace` destructure already strips these fields for UNKNOWN classes — the known non-caster path just never got the same line.
  - **P2 — numeric-string parity on the wire:** `slot_level: "2"` fails `Number.isFinite` in the normalizer AND in `chooseSlotLevel`, so the cast silently downcasts (reproduced: Cure Wounds at level 1, 1d8, no note). The exchange cast slot has the identical test.
  - **P2 — the slot tally and Arcane Recovery flag are the heal's finite-gated outliers:** `used: "4"` → 0 (a load that REFILLS magic — the wrong direction); `arcaneRecovery.used: "0"` → `=== 0` false → a short rest silently skips recovery and never re-types it (reproduced).
  - **P2 — object `target` → "[object Object]"** in two visible lines (Spare the Dying, the Cure Wounds rejection); the Scribe cast audit `String()`s the same way. Nit: `sanitizeSustainedSpell` keeps `targetId` untyped (harmless — `===` only).

- **Suggested improvements:** (1) strip `spellSlots`/`sustainedSpell` for non-casters in `healLoadedCharacter` + gate CombatPanel on `isSpellcaster`; (2) `toFiniteNumber` on `slot_level` (both normalizers) and `toInt` on `used`; (3) string-or-drop `target`; (4) the pins.

- **Scope examined:** `writeChronicleChapters` end to end with hostile passages and hostile chapters; `renderTranscript`/`stripEventBlocks` against hostile messages; the load heal; the tab's render and the async write flow against a mid-write `LOAD_GAME`; `chronicleToMarkdown`. **Verified fixed since 09-04:** the entry heal and the `kind: 'error'` stamping — in code and pinned. **Verified sound:** `collectNarrativeEntries` rejects non-string content, so an object message never reaches the transcript; the parser stores NARRATIVE-only content, so `stripEventBlocks`' lowercase-```json-only regex is a belt (the ```JSON and bare-fence shapes the 09-05 parser recognizes are stripped at parse time — verified "The door opens." / "Rain."); salvage boundary math; `disabled={writing}`; a junk `createdAt` renders "Invalid Date", never throws.

  - **P1 — the part budget is in CHUNKS, the clamp is in CHARACTERS.** `CHUNKS_PER_CHAPTER = 10` assumes ~4.5k chars per passage; nothing bounds a passage. Reproduced: 10 × 7,000-char passages (≈1,100 words — a modest overshoot of the 300–700 aim) → 70,008 chars → `appendChronicleChapter` slices to 60,000 mid-sentence, 10,008 chars gone with no warning, `toIndex` claiming the whole span. The 08-29 P1's shape, one level down.

Reproduced at the reducer level: campaign A's prose lands as "Chapter 1" (`toIndex` 12) on campaign B's 8-message chronicle. Likelihood is honest (the player must load another campaign mid-write) but the outcome is silent, persisted cross-campaign contamination.
  - **P2 — `toIndex` is coerced but never clamped to the transcript:** `1e15` loads intact → "No new play" forever, every close throws (reproduced); Remove chapter recovers but nothing says so. The 09-10 `maxMessageCount` clamp is the pattern. Nits: the heal spreads `...entry` (unknown keys persist) and the write side stores `-5`/`3.7` raw.
  - **P2 — `session.chapterCloseSuggested` is untyped at load** (`session.name` is the only typed session scalar; the living-world sanitizer covers the three `pending*` markers, not this one) and `ChronicleTab` renders `suggestedTitle` as a React child — reproduced `{ title: {} }` surviving load → the Journal panel's boundary on open whenever a chapter is writable.
  - **Test depth:** no test meets the clamp, races a load, or loads a future `toIndex`/object title.
- **Suggested improvements:** (1) close a part by accumulated characters too (or clip per passage with a `warning`); (2) session-id + loadNonce guard on the async close (and Deepen memory / portrait writes); (3) clamp `toIndex` at load; (4) type `chapterCloseSuggested`; (5) the pins.

### Process notes
- Queue was EMPTY at run start; ten items added (3 P1). Coverage snapshot not refreshed (3 days).
- **New Lap-2 sub-pattern: a heal gated on a class predicate leaves the OTHER class's field untyped.** `healLoadedCharacter` types `spellSlots` only for casters; everything downstream that gates on the same predicate is safe, and the one consumer that gates on truthiness instead is the hole. Rule: a class-conditional heal must either type the field for everyone or strip it for the other class — and grep the field's consumers for a gate that differs from the heal's.
- **Second: a budget counted in one unit and a clamp in another is not a budget.** Chunk count vs character count here; the 09-12 "bound behind a type check" is the same family (the bound's guard is a proxy for the thing bounded).
- **Third: an async UI flow that captures `state` and dispatches later must carry the session identity.** The AppShell key remount protects RENDERING against a mid-flight load, not closures; `flushAutoSave({ action })` then persists the misdelivery. Chapter close is the longest such flow; Deepen memory and portrait generation are the same shape.

- Session ran on a `claude/*` working branch; per the master-only convention the result lands on `origin master` directly.

### character-vault (`engine/characterVault.js`, `engine/characterUtils.js`, `START_CHARACTER`, the roster flows in `CharacterCreation.jsx` + `projectRosterEntry`, `healUnknownClassRace` as the load twin) — Lap 2
- **Scope examined:** `sanitizeCharacter` field by field (name, the race/class gate, abilities, level/exp, modern vs legacy maxHP, skills/expertise, coin, identity text, portrait, ASI/style/archetype), `sanitizeInventory` with `normalizeItem` as its core, `parseCharacterExport`, begin-from-roster/import/delete (all `rosterError`-guarded since 09-03), `projectRosterEntry`, `START_CHARACTER`. **Verified fixed since 09-03:** all four queue items — the weapon-damage bound, the dead-hero ruling (roster is a template), the skill/expertise allowance clamps, loud roster failures — plus the 09-11 roster projection; all pinned. Sound: the coin band, the exp/level clamps, the fixed-average maxHP recompute, the portrait allowlist, `equipped === true` only, ids minted.
- **Findings:**
  - **P1 — the race/class gate admits inherited keys.** `RACES[raw.race]` / `CLASSES[raw.class]` is a truthiness test on a plain object, so `constructor`, `__proto__`, `toString`, `hasOwnProperty` pass. Reproduced: `class: 'constructor'` imports a level-3 hero with no features, no class resources, no saving throws and `hitDice.die` undefined (maxHP 12 = the no-hit-die `10 + CON` fallback); the prompt says "**Class:** Object (Level 3)" and "Hit Dice: 3/3 dundefined"; the first-session short rest heals 0 forever without throwing (NaN `expectedHealPerDie` → the spend loop never runs). Legacy path (no `createdAt`): maxHP/currentHP `NaN` — sticky. `healUnknownClassRace` runs the same truthy test, so the save round-trips; `normalizeFightingStyle`/`normalizeMartialArchetype` accept `'constructor'` the same way (the Fighter silently loses their style). A hand-edited file only — but it is the one identity gate the vault has, and the load heal then trusts what passed it.
  - **P2 — identity text is `String(x || '')`** (name/gender/notes/appearance/background/portraitPrompt), the idiom the 09-09 sweep retired from the load heal: `name: {}` imports as "[object Object]" and passes the no-name check; `gender: {}` reaches the DM prompt and the art director's inviolable-identity line; `appearance: {}` becomes the Scribe merge base. The untrusted file is now the LESS strict boundary.
  - **P2 — string boolean flags:** `twoHanded: 'no'` on an imported catalog Longsword is truthy → the equipped Shield is sheathed (reproduced); `isShield: 'no'` on a gear row equips as a shield and prices +2 as a gift. The DM path mis-coerces the other way: `!!"false"` is `true` (reproduced through `parseResponse` → `applyEvents`).
  - **Test depth:** no vault test feeds a prototype-key race/class/style, a non-string name/gender, or a string flag.
- **Suggested improvements:** (1) one `isKnownRace`/`isKnownClass` (`Object.hasOwn`) used by the vault, `healUnknownClassRace`, the style/archetype normalizers and the display-name helpers; (2) `cleanTextField` in the vault with the same clamps; (3) a shared `toFlag` for item booleans (vault/load in `normalizeItem`, DM in applyEvents); (4) the pins.

### inventory-economy (`data/items.js`, `engine/equipment.js`, `engine/currency.js`, `engine/companionGear.js`, `handlers/inventory.js`, `handlers/economy.js`, the ref/ledger/stack helpers in `handlers/shared.js`, the item channels through `eventChannels.js` → `applyEvents.js`, `healEquippedSlots` as the load twin) — Lap 2
- **Scope examined:** `normalizeItem`/`normalizeItemKey`/`parseCountedItemName` clamp by clamp (quantity, valueCp, magic/attack/damage/AC bonuses, baseAC, shieldAC, weapon dice bounded — `type`, `healing`, non-weapon `damage`, `damageType`, the boolean flags, `description`, `rarity` not); the four DM channels end to end; the by-ref ladder with object refs (safe — everything is `String()`ed); the ledgers (typed by `sanitizeRecentTransaction`); `stackIdentity`/`addOrStackItem`/`consumeItem`; `GIVE_GEAR_TO_COMPANION`; the load path. **Verified fixed since 09-03:** all six queue items — quantity-aware `items_lost`, the preposition guard, stacking + the load fold, finite+trunc sale quantity, covered purchases ledgered `ignored`, the companion shield memory — pinned. Verified sound: every loaded row passes through `normalizeItem` in the unconditional `healEquippedSlots`, which always rewrites `valueCp` finite-or-undefined — so `SELL_ITEM`'s `(item.valueCp || 0) / 2` cannot meet an object (it would `NaN` the proceeds and `fromCopper` the purse to zero, the 09-11 class); a dependency worth a comment, not a finding. Sale proceeds clamp at 10,000 gp (reproduced `priceCp: 1e12`).
- **Findings:**
  - **P1 — a prototype key in an item NAME throws out of `normalizeItem`, on every write path.** `normalizeItemKey` reads `ITEM_CATALOG[raw]` and `NAME_TO_KEY[lower]` as plain-object lookups. Reproduced: `'Constructor'` → `NAME_TO_KEY['constructor']` returns the `Object` FUNCTION as the key → `ITEM_CATALOG[fn]` undefined → `base.quantity` TypeError; exact-case `'constructor'` mints an item NAMED "Object"; `'__proto__'` mints a nameless row. `items_found: ["Constructor"]` → `ADD_ITEM` throws AFTER `CLAIM_LOOT_SOURCE` (the coin and quest in the same response never dispatch, and a retry pays nothing because the source is claimed); `PURCHASE_ITEM` throws the same; a stored row with that name makes `LOAD_GAME` throw — an unloadable campaign; the vault import fails with the raw TypeError text. A reducer throw surfaces in React's render → the root "Quest Forge" boundary. The by-name remove/equip/sell lanes are safe (they compare `i.itemKey === nameKey`). Likelihood is honest — a fantasy DM never names loot "Constructor"; a hostile save can — and the fix is one `Object.hasOwn`.
  - **P2 — the damage bound is TYPE-gated and `type` is untyped.** `damage` on a `type: 'gear'` row survives unbounded — `'99d12'`, or an OBJECT (reproduced: the inventory block prints "Cursed Idol [[object Object] x]" and `InventoryPanel.jsx:177` renders `{item.damage}` as a React child → Inventory boundary); `type: 'Weapon'` (capitalized, LLM-plausible) keeps `'99d12'`, is not equippable, and reads as a weapon in the prompt; `type: {}` stores an object. `damageType`/`rarity`/`description`/`consumableType`/`actionType` ride `...source` untyped.
  - **P2 — `healing` is the sibling with no bound** (the 09-03 damage class one field over): a non-catalog healing consumable with `healing: '100d1000+1000'` imports and grants intact — reproduced: one bonus-action drink rolled 100 dice and healed 1 → 60/60. The only ceiling is `parseNotation`'s.
  - **P2 — numeric-string parity:** the coin `clamp` coerces `"5"`, enemy stats coerce since 09-11, but item `quantity` and purchase `priceCp` test `Number.isFinite` on the raw value. Reproduced: `purchase { name: 'Torch', quantity: '5', priceCp: '50' }` → ONE torch for 1 cp — the DM's count and price silently dropped; `sell { quantity: 'all' }` → one unit while `items_lost` honors "all". Minor: `purchase { item: [], priceCp: 300 }` buys "Unknown item" for 3 gp.
  - **Test depth:** no test names an item with a prototype key, feeds a non-weapon `damage`, a capitalized `type`, a hostile `healing`, or string `quantity`/`priceCp` on purchase.
- **Suggested improvements:** (1) `Object.hasOwn` in `normalizeItemKey` for both tables; (2) bound `damage`/`damageVersatile` whenever present + lowercase/whitelist `type`, string-or-drop the descriptive fields; (3) a `boundHealingNotation` (count ≤ 10, sides ≤ 12, flat ≤ 20 — a 5e Supreme is 10d4+20); (4) coerce numeric strings through the shared `clamp` before the finite checks, accept "all" on the sale side; (5) the pins.

### Process notes
- Queue was EMPTY at run start; eight items added (2 P1). Coverage snapshot not refreshed (2 days).
- **New Lap-2 sub-pattern: a plain-object table is a Map with a hole in it.** `TABLE[key]` truthiness admits `constructor` / `__proto__` / `toString` / `valueOf` / `hasOwnProperty` from any string-valued channel — and the two failure shapes differ by table: a table of OBJECTS (`RACES`, `CLASSES`) yields a featureless-but-truthy record that every downstream `?.` reads happily (silent), while a table of STRINGS (`NAME_TO_KEY`) yields a function that the next lookup dereferences (throw). Sites found this run: `RACES`/`CLASSES` at the vault gate and the load heal, `fightingStyles`/`martialArchetypes`, `ITEM_CATALOG`, `NAME_TO_KEY`. The rest of the family to grep (not reproduced): the ~30 `CLASSES[…]`/`RACES[…]` reads are all downstream of those two gates, so one `Object.hasOwn` helper at the gates covers them; `SPELLS[…]` on the `spell_cast` name and `CONDITION_EFFECTS[…]` deserve the same one-line check. Add "grep `TABLE[` for external-string keys" to the lap-opener steps.
- The 09-03 "list every clamp, ask which sibling has none" step earned its keep twice more (`healing`; the type-gated `damage`) — and its inverse is worth naming: **a bound behind a type check is only as strong as the type field**, which here is DM-authored and never whitelisted.

## 2026-09-11 — combat-exchange + persistence (Lap 2: robustness against hostile input)

`npm test`: 2353 passing / 130 files (green; hosted container again shipped without `node_modules` — `npm install` first).

Rotation: the last-6 union (origin == HEAD after fetch) excludes roll-resolution, cloud-sync (09-10), dice-engine, scene-art (09-09), hidden-fronts, living-world (09-08), progression, chat-orchestration (09-07), scribe, prompt-building, memory-journal, story-memory (09-06). Least recently audited eligible: the two remaining 09-02 features — **combat-exchange** + **persistence** — which are also two of the snapshot's weak spots (`combatExchange.js` 85.44, `persistence.js` 87.93, `handlers/session.js` 85.71). Lap 2 lens: malformed DM envelopes and malformed/stale saves, read with the 09-10 lap-opener twin — list the FIELDS each sanitizer spreads through. Every finding below was **reproduced empirically** against the live reducer/prompt/engine with a throwaway vitest file (deleted, never committed; zero repo changes). Coverage snapshot is one day old — not refreshed.

### combat-exchange (`engine/combatExchange.js`, `state/handlers/combat.js`, `engine/enemyStats.js` at the load boundary, the `combat` branch of `validateSaveState`, the three ChatPanel engine effects, `CombatPanel.jsx`) — Lap 2
- **Scope examined:** the DM envelope end to end (`normalizeCombatExchange` + `reconcileStartingCombatExchange` + `validatePlayerSlots` — every field is typed, capped, and whitelisted; an unknown action/target is dropped or rejected visibly, a non-object envelope is null: sound), `START_COMBAT`'s whitelist projection (sound), `APPLY_COMBAT_EXCHANGE`'s replay/phase guards (sound), and the LOAD boundary field by field: `enemies` (typed), `flankedEnemyIds`/`surprise`/`currentTurn`/`queuedExchange` (typed), then `turnOrder`, `round`, `active`, `xpAwarded`, `bonusActionUsed`, `lastExchangeResult.{events,postState.player,postState.companions}`, and unknown keys — all raw. **Verified fixed since 09-02:** all four queue items — `terminalState` asks `isLowLevelSolo` on the dying branch, the party commits between the death save and damage, the natural-20 revive precedes the enemy phase, `applyEvents`' `player_death` uses the live predicate; plus the 09-09 companion typing holds inside the exchange (`Number()` on the attack bonus, bounded dice).
- **Findings:**
  - **P1 — `turnOrder` entries load untyped and five consumers dereference them.** The load guard reads `actor?.type` for its own `playerIdx` and then hands the array through raw (`session.js:263-271`). Reproduced with one `null` entry (a JSON round-trip hole — the 07-25 messages class; cloud saves are a round-trip): `buildSystemPrompt` throws `reading 'name'` on EVERY turn (`promptBuilder.js:1031`), `APPLY_COMBAT_EXCHANGE` and `REJECT_COMBAT_EXCHANGE` throw `reading 'type'` inside the reducer (`combat.js:287,362`; `COMPLETE` at `:340` too), and in phase `opening` `planOpeningExchange` throws `reading 'id'` (`combatExchange.js:1681`) → the 09-09 belt dispatches REJECT → REJECT's phase guard returns the state untouched in OPENING → the effect's deps never change → phase `opening` forever. The one manual exit, the panel's End Combat button, is gated on no living foes. A deadlocked campaign from one array hole. An object `name` / string `initiative` renders "→ [object Object] (init: abc)" in the prompt and a React child throw in the panel (`CombatPanel.jsx:93` — inside the Chat boundary, so the whole chat dies).
  - **P1 — the stored exchange result is half-typed, and its consumer runs un-caught inside a React effect.** `sanitizeStoredExchangeResult` projects the enemy snapshot (the 08-29 fix) but passes `events` (`session.js:76`), `postState.companions` (`:66`) and `postState.player` (`:49`) through raw; `combatNarrationPrompt(result)` is called synchronously in the narration effect (`ChatPanel.jsx:512`) — the two plan effects got their try on 09-09, this one did not. Reproduced: a `null` event or companion in an `awaiting_narration` save throws out of the effect → Chat boundary; Try Again remounts into the same throw, "Retry narration" re-fires it, and `COMPLETE_COMBAT_NARRATION` requires the call to succeed — no UI path leaves the phase. Object names print "[object Object]" into the AUTHORITATIVE post-state the DM is told never to contradict; a junk attack event prints "Rolled **[object Object]** vs AC undefined; **Hit for xxx damage.** … alive at nope/28 HP"; and `events` are unclamped where `summary` is capped at 12000 — 100 stored 20k-char notes built a **2,001,123-character** narration prompt.
  - **P2 — the rest of the envelope is untyped:** `round: "3"` → `COMPLETE_COMBAT_NARRATION`'s `round + 1` → `"31"` (reproduced), an object → "Round [object Object]" in the prompt and a React child throw in the panel header; `active: "false"` loads as a live foe-less fight (ACTIVE COMBAT block every turn; escapable); `xpAwarded: "no"` is truthy → END_COMBAT's fallback pays nothing for slain foes (reproduced 900 → 900); `bonusActionUsed: "no"` refuses Second Wind and the bonus-cast lane all round; unknown keys re-persist through `{ ...merged }`.
  - **P2 (parity) — enemy ids are not re-canonicalized at load.** `sanitizeLoadedEnemy` keeps `id` as-is (`undefined` allowed, duplicates untouched) while START_COMBAT dedupes through `canonicalEnemyId`. Reproduced: two foes sharing an id → `UPDATE_ENEMY { hp: 0 }` kills both, and only the first ever receives an intent; id-less foes render `(id: undefined)` so the DM has no handle.
  - **Test depth:** no LOAD_GAME test carries a null/object turn-order entry, a string round, a null event/companion in a stored result, or duplicate/absent enemy ids.
- **Suggested improvements:** (1) a typed `turnOrder` entry sanitizer at load (type whitelist, string id/name, finite initiative — drop otherwise) + `?.` on the reducer's three `findIndex` reads; (2) type events/player/companions inside `sanitizeStoredExchangeResult` (event-type whitelist, clamped text, finite numbers) and try-wrap the narration effect's prompt build; (3) boolean-coerce the flags, clamp `round`, project known keys; (4) `canonicalEnemyId` with a fresh `usedIds` at load; (5) the pins.

### persistence (`state/persistence.js`, `state/migrations.js` — `healLoadedCharacter` and the inventory heals, the `validateSaveState` list guards, `autosavePolicy.js`, the roster store + its render) — Lap 2
- **Scope examined:** every IDB path through `withDb` (sound: one close site, `onversionchange`, per-record non-fatal migration), `serializeGameState`/`buildSaveMetadata`/`projectSaveMetadata` (typed since 09-10), `loadSettings` (outer guard; the one `settings.x?.trim()` left is `machinery.js:25`, harmless), `getSaveVersion` (junk/future stamps handled), and `healLoadedCharacter` FIELD BY FIELD against what it spreads: level/exp/HP/abilities/hit dice/conditions/identity/death state typed — `gold`/`silver`/`copper`, `class`/`race` not; the list guards of `validateSaveState` against each list. **Verified fixed since 09-02:** all four queue items — `loadAutoSave` rejects and the boot screen sets `loadError`, `withDb` closes on any throw, the migration is per-record non-fatal, the flush no longer double-writes.
- **Findings:**
  - **P1 — the purse loads untyped, and the currency kernel turns one bad field into an empty purse.** `healLoadedCharacter` spreads `gold`/`silver`/`copper` raw (`migrations.js:315-340`); `toCopper` does `Math.max(0, Math.trunc(x))` (`currency.js:5-7`), so a non-numeric value makes the total `NaN` and `fromCopper(NaN)` yields zero. Reproduced: `gold: {}` (or `"abc"`) beside 40 sp 5 cp → one "+1 gp" grant → **0 gp 0 sp 0 cp**, with the receipt line reading "purse: 0 cp" as if that were the arithmetic; until then the prompt's Wealth line says "[object Object] gp". A numeric string coerces fine, a negative floors silently, and `gold: 1e15` survives with no ceiling where every DM-side coin channel is capped. The 09-10 pattern exactly: the sibling numeric fields got `toInt`, these three did not.
  - **P1 — `class`/`race` are the two identity fields the 09-09 sweep did not type, and they key every rules lookup.** The vault's `sanitizeCharacter` THROWS on an unknown value ("this hero may come from an older version of the game", `characterVault.js:103-106`); the live-save heal never looks. Reproduced: `class: {}` → "**Class:** [object Object]" in the prompt, `classResources` `{}` (a Fighter silently loses Second Wind / Action Surge / Extra Attack / Fighting Style), hit die d8, the object copied into `buildSaveMetadata`, and a React child throw at `{charClass?.name || character.class}` on the sheet and the profile screen. The plausible STALE shape is a string: a pre-balance-overhaul save whose hero is a cut class or race (`paladin`, `halfling` — the 8-race/6-class era) loads featureless, d8, with the weapon-proficiency penalty and no notice — the vault says why; the save path says nothing.
  - **P2 — local `loadGame` has no plain-object guard** (`persistence.js:333-340`) — `cloudSync.js` got `asSaveObject` on both parse paths on 07-25. Reproduced at the reducer: a string/array `state` spreads index keys into live state, `character` is null, the app silently shows the start screen again with the slot still listed, and Upload-local-saves ships the same junk to the cloud.
  - **P2 — `inventory` is the one persisted list whose entries are not object-filtered** (`session.js:107`): `null`/`42` rows become permanent "Unknown item" gear via `normalizeItem`'s default (reproduced), an object `name` survives as `{ x: 1 }` → "[object Object]" in the inventory block and a React child throw in the Inventory panel. Minor twin: `listRosterCharacters` returns raw IDB records rendered as `{entry.name}` / `Lv.{entry.level}` (`CharacterCreation.jsx:356-363`) — the 09-10 "a render is a trust boundary" class, one list over.
  - **Test depth:** no test loads an object/string purse, an unknown or object class/race, a null inventory row, or a non-object payload record.
- **Suggested improvements:** (1) `toInt`-clamp the three coin fields at load (0 ..≤ the sale ceiling); (2) whitelist `class`/`race` against the data tables with a fallback + a one-time visible line mirroring the vault's message; (3) `asSaveObject` in `loadGame` + `setLoadError`; (4) object-filter + name-type inventory rows, project roster rows; (5) the pins.

### Process notes
- Queue was EMPTY at run start; ten items added (4 P1). Coverage snapshot not refreshed (1 day).
- Lap-2 pattern, fifth pair running, now with a name for its two halves. **Half one — the untyped remainder of a spread:** every P1 here again hides behind a sanitizer that types its favorite fields and spreads the rest (`healLoadedCharacter` → purse and class; `sanitizeStoredExchangeResult` → events and companions; the combat branch → `turnOrder`). The 09-10 lap-opener step (list the FIELDS per record) found all four in one pass — keep it. **Half two — a guard that protects only its own read:** `turnOrder.findIndex(actor => actor?.type …)` guards the load's own lookup and then hands the array to five consumers that don't. When a sanitizer optional-chains its own access to an entry, that is the tell that the entry should be typed or dropped, not read carefully once.
- New sub-pattern: **a belt that dispatches an action must check the action's own phase guard.** The 09-09 plan-effect try dispatches REJECT on a throw, but REJECT is a no-op outside AWAITING_PLAYER/INTENT — so in OPENING the belt is a silent swallow and the phase never moves. Any "reject on throw" belt should assert the reject actually transitioned state.
- Environment: same as 09-10 — no `node_modules` in the container; vitest drops `console.log`, so the repro wrote its evidence to a scratch file.

## 2026-09-10 — roll-resolution + cloud-sync (Lap 2: robustness against hostile input)

`npm test`: 2296 passing / 123 files (green; hosted container again shipped without `node_modules` — `npm install` first).

Rotation: the last-6 union (origin == HEAD after fetch) excludes dice-engine, scene-art (09-09), hidden-fronts, living-world (09-08), progression, chat-orchestration (09-07), scribe, prompt-building, memory-journal, story-memory, providers-adapter, vector-memory-rag (09-06). Least recently audited eligible: the four 09-02 features; coverage tie-break (auth.js 78.94, rollResolver.js 86.79) → **roll-resolution** + **cloud-sync**. Lap 2 lens: malformed DM output, malformed/stale saves, and — for cloud — malformed Firestore documents (a metadata doc or chunk is data another device, an older build, or the Firebase console wrote). Every finding below was **reproduced empirically** against the live engine/reducer/list code with a throwaway vitest file (deleted, never committed; zero repo changes). Coverage snapshot refreshed (7 days old).

### roll-resolution (`engine/rollResolver.js`, `engine/outOfCombatRollPolicy.js`, `engine/roleplayCheck.js`, the proposal/ruling/heat ledgers at the load boundary, the accept/challenge flows in `turnOrchestrator.js`) — Lap 2
- **Scope examined:** every trust boundary a roll crosses — the parser's `normalizeRequestedRoll`, the semantic + regex text-roll detectors, the arbiter's LLM verdict, `sanitizePendingRoleplayCheck`/`normalizeRollRuling`/`sanitizeRecentChecks` at PROPOSE and at LOAD_GAME, `resolveRolls`' four lanes (player / npc / companion / death save) against a loaded hero and party, `healLoadedCharacter` for the fields those lanes read. **Verified fixed since 09-02:** all six queue items — proposal rolls typed through the parser normalizer (dc coerced + clamped, string-or-null text), heat replacement keyed on lineage, the arbiter's sync rules as a FLOOR with coerced index, the outcome call as a first-class turn (second argument pinned), the death-save mirror asking `isLowLevelSolo` live, the nothing-to-roll reveal, `hasAlly` on the working party. Verified sound under hostile reading: `validateEnemyAttackBonus`/`sanitizeEnemyDamage` on both NPC lanes, companion `attackBonus`/`ac` clamped by `normalizeCompanion` (the 09-09 fix holds out of combat too), `guardedList` dropping non-object roll entries from both detectors, loot on a proposal never granted engine-side, `combat.active` rejection before any die.
- **Findings:**
  - **P1 — the hero's death state loads untyped, and the tally arithmetic trusts it.** `healLoadedCharacter` types level/HP/abilities/hit dice/conditions/identity and spreads `dying`/`deathSaves`/`lowLevelDefeat`/`isDead` raw (`migrations.js:299-317`); `DEATH_SAVE_RESULT` does `prev.failures + (die === 1 ? 2 : 1)` on whatever loaded (`character.js:254-274`). Reproduced: `deathSaves: { successes: "2", failures: "1" }` + a die of 5 → `"1" + 1 = "11"`, `"11" >= 3` → **`isDead: true` on the first failed save** — the one irreversible outcome in the game, from one string in a save; `successes: "2"` + a 12 → stable at one success; `failures: -1000` → five natural 1s and the hero cannot die; `dying: "false"` loads as the string and reads truthy in every consumer (death saves requested, the safety block, the ADD_MESSAGE wake). `resolveDeathSave` mirrors the same concatenation (`rollResolver.js:720-732`), so the DM summary confirms the wrong answer ("THE PLAYER CHARACTER IS DEAD"). The 09-09 pattern once more: the sibling numeric fields got `toInt`, these four didn't.
  - **P2 — future-stamped ledger entries never expire.** `normalizeRollRuling` floors `atMessageCount` at 0 and `sanitizeRecentChecks` floors `messageIndex` the same way (`roleplayCheck.js:172,139`); neither has a ceiling, and `dc` is stored unclamped (`:168`, reproduced `-1000000000`). Reproduced: a `withdrawn` ruling with `atMessageCount: 1e12` and `location: null` renders in `## RECENT TABLE RULINGS — BINDING` ("this approach succeeds through roleplay without dice") at 200 messages AND at another location — `messageCount - atMessageCount <= 24` is true forever and a null location matches everywhere, so it binds until five newer rulings push it out; three checks at `messageIndex: 1e9` read as "3 checks under pressure in the last scenes, some against strong opposition" on every turn (+3 heat, `worldTempo.js:354-360` — `conversationalDistance` iterates nothing for a future anchor and returns 0), so the thermostat runs hot for the rest of the campaign.
  - **P2 — a skill-less check is a dead card.** `normalizeRequestedRoll({ type: 'skill_check', dc: 12, description: 'Make a Perception check to spot the ambush' })` — the DM's most common omission shape, the skill named only in prose — types `skill: null`; `sanitizePendingRoleplayCheck` keeps the roll, the proposal card renders Roll / Challenge / Change approach, and `resolveRolls` skips it without a note (`rollResolver.js:180` — the `roll.skill && character` branch is the only player lane). Reproduced: 0 results, 0 dispatches, so the whole proposal lands on the 09-02 "None of the proposed rolls could be resolved" set-aside — the player clicked Roll and got an apology. The regex detector already maps prose to `KNOWN_SKILLS`; the parser should do the same from `description`, or drop the roll at the boundary so nothing stages.
  - **P2 — the parser clamps half the roll's text fields.** `reason`/`opposition`/`failure_stakes`/… are sliced to 500; `description`/`skill`/`attacker`/`target`/`damage`/`notation` are not (`eventChannels.js:119-142`; reproduced a 50,000-char description and 5,000-char target). The proposal caps them one step later (300/80/120/40), but the arbiter's `JSON.stringify` payload (`outOfCombatRollPolicy.js:97`) and the parser's debug line ride the raw text — a Lap 3 cost hiding in a Lap 2 gap.
  - **P2 (parity, dormant) —** the hero's DM-supplied `damage` fallback is the one attack lane without a bounder: `getWeaponDamageNotation(character, inventory, roll.damage || '1d4')` (`rollResolver.js:205`) returns `100d1000+3` for a weaponless hero (reproduced) where the NPC/companion lanes pass `sanitizeEnemyDamage`. Dormant: `combat.enemies` is empty after END_COMBAT, so out of combat the damage never applies — but the roll line would show it, and the asymmetry is exactly the shape that bit companions on 09-09.
  - **P2 (minor) —** companion `conditions` elements are untyped (`normalizeCompanion` keeps any array as-is, `shared.js:595`; the hero got `normalizeConditionList` on 09-05). Reproduced: `[{ junk: 1 }, 'prone']` loads; both roll kernels tolerate it via `String(raw)`, but the COMPANIONS prompt block prints "[object Object]" on every turn.
  - **Test depth:** no test loads string/negative death tallies or a string `dying`, a future-stamped ruling or check, or a skill-less roll into `resolveRolls`.
- **Suggested improvements:** (1) `toInt`-clamp both tallies 0..3 and boolean-coerce the four flags in `healLoadedCharacter`, `Number()` in the reducer and the mirror as a belt; (2) clamp ledger stamps to the live message count at load (drop future ones) and `dc` to 0..30 in `normalizeRollRuling`; (3) derive-or-drop the skill at the parser; (4) clamp the six text fields there; (5) bound the hero fallback; (6) companion conditions through the shared normalizer; (7) the pins.

### cloud-sync (`state/cloudSync.js`, `state/auth.js`, `config/firebase.js`, `firestore.rules`, the two save-list renders in `App.jsx`/`SettingsModal.jsx`, `buildSaveMetadata` and the load-side fields it copies) — Lap 2
- **Scope examined:** every value Firestore hands back — the metadata doc (`payloadChunks`, `payload`, `slotId`, the display fields), chunk docs (`index`, `data`), the parsed payload — and every value the app hands Firestore (`slotId` from the UI, metadata from live state); `initializeFirebase`/`getFirebaseConfigError` against a junk localStorage config; `subscribeToAuth` → `SET_USER` (only `uid`/`email`/`isGuest` cross — sound); the rules file (per-user match + chunks, deny-all default — sound; no shape rule is the right call for BYO Firebase). **Verified fixed since 09-02:** all three queue items — `{ ok, reason, message }` with the 9 MiB pre-flight (tested for `too-large` and `permission-denied`), `handleSave`/`handleOverwrite` catch + status, per-slot isolation in the upload loop. Verified sound: `asSaveObject` on both load branches, the missing-chunk throw → null (a string `payloadChunks: "3"` coerces through `>`/`<` and reassembles correctly — reproduced), non-integer/non-string chunk records skipped, a surrogate-safe split, `deleteApp` on a changed project.
- **Findings:**
  - **P1 — save-list metadata is an untyped render boundary on both lists, fed by two untyped load fields.** `LOAD_GAME` keeps `currentLocation: payload.currentLocation || null` and `session.name` raw (`session.js:188,271` — `sanitizeLivingWorldSession` types only its five sub-objects), `buildSaveMetadata` copies them into every save's metadata (`persistence.js:218,229`), `listCloudSaves` returns the Firestore doc verbatim (`cloudSync.js:234-243`), and the start screen (`App.jsx:199-222` — the one screen with no boundary of its own) and the Settings Saves tab (`SettingsModal.jsx:662-680`) render `{save.name}`/`{save.characterName}`/`{save.location}` as React children. Reproduced: an object `session.name`/`currentLocation` in a save survives LOAD_GAME, lands in the metadata of the next local AND cloud save, and React throws "Objects are not valid as a React child" for it — Load Game crashes the root boundary (Try Again remounts the same list), the Saves tab crashes the Settings boundary, so every save on the device becomes unreachable from the UI; meanwhile `buildSystemPrompt` throws `loc.trim is not a function` on every turn of the loaded campaign (`normalizeLocationName`, `worldJournal.js:26`, reached from the prompt build — the 09-09 `.trim()` class, one field the sweep missed). A metadata doc with an object `name` and no `slotId` (another device, an older build, a console edit) does the same on its own and cannot be deleted from the app (next finding). The local list has the same shape; cloud is where foreign data enters.
  - **P2 — the stale-chunk sweeps trust the stored count without a bound.** `saveGameToCloud` (`cloudSync.js:154-156`) and `deleteGameFromCloud` (`:268-270`) loop `for (i < previousChunkCount)` queuing one `transaction.delete` per iteration. Reproduced: `payloadChunks: 200000` on the existing doc queued 199,999 deletes on save and 150,001 on delete (the real SDK would blow the request ceiling after minutes of CPU); `Infinity` never terminates, so a corrupt count makes the slot un-overwritable and un-deletable from the app — the one cloud path with no way out but the console. A save is ≤ ~32 chunks by the 9 MiB pre-flight; `Number.isInteger` + a cap of 64 closes it.
  - **P2 — list rows are addressed by the stored `slotId` FIELD, not `doc.id`** (`cloudSync.js:241-242`). Reproduced: a doc without one is returned with `slotId` undefined — rendered under key `cloud-undefined`, Load reads an auto-id doc ("not found"), Overwrite writes a fresh doc, Delete refuses (`!slotId`) — a permanent phantom row; a doc whose field differs from its id loads or deletes the WRONG document. `slotId: data.slotId || doc.id`.
  - **P2 — `getFirebaseConfigError` is a `?.trim()` site the 09-09 sweep did not reach** (`firebase.js:13-15`). Reproduced: a non-string `firebaseConfig.apiKey` in localStorage settings throws `config.apiKey?.trim is not a function` OUTSIDE `initializeFirebase`'s try; `GameContext.initAuth` (`:127-142`) rejects unhandled and never dispatches `SIGNOUT_USER`, so `isAuthLoading` stays true forever ("Checking cloud sync..." on the start screen) and the Settings Connect handler throws on click. `loadSettings` types only the outer object.
  - **Test depth:** no test feeds a junk `payloadChunks` on an EXISTING doc, a slotId-less or object-valued metadata doc, a non-string config field, or an object `currentLocation`/`session.name` through LOAD_GAME → `buildSaveMetadata` → render.
- **Suggested improvements:** (1) `cleanTextField` on `currentLocation` and `session.name` at load, and ONE `projectSaveMetadata` (string-or-'' text, finite numbers, `slotId: data.slotId || doc.id`) shared by `listSaves` and `listCloudSaves` — the render then trusts a typed row, not a document; (2) integer-guard + cap the two sweeps; (3) `String(x ?? '').trim()` in the config check; (4) the pins.

## 2026-09-09 — dice-engine + scene-art (Lap 2: robustness against hostile input)

`npm test`: 2247 passing / 113 files (green; the hosted container shipped without `node_modules` — `npm install` first).

Rotation: the last-6 union (origin == HEAD) excludes hidden-fronts, living-world (09-08), progression, chat-orchestration (09-07), scribe, prompt-building, memory-journal, story-memory, providers-adapter, vector-memory-rag (09-06), response-parsing, enemy-stats-conditions (09-05). Least recently audited eligible: the two 09-01 features → **dice-engine** + **scene-art** (the same pair that opened Lap 1 on 09-01 and Lap 4 on 08-20 — the rotation's rhythm). Lap 2 lens: malformed DM output and malformed/stale saves. Every finding below was **reproduced empirically** against the live engine/reducer with a throwaway vitest file (deleted, never committed; zero repo changes). Coverage snapshot (09-03) is 6 days old — not refreshed.

### dice-engine (`engine/dice.ts` + every notation that reaches it: companion/enemy/item/spell damage and healing, the `rollHistory` ledger) — Lap 2
- **Scope examined:** `dice.ts` end to end; every `parseNotation`/`rollNotation`/`rollWithModifier` call site (`combatMath.rollDamage` and its two `onInvalid` modes, the exchange machine's companion/spell/dart paths, `rollResolver`'s player/npc/damage lanes, `USE_ITEM` ×2, Second Wind, Short Rest, initiative); the trust boundaries feeding them — `boundWeaponDamage` (hero), `sanitizeEnemyDamage` (enemies + the DM's out-of-combat `npc_attack` damage), `normalizeCompanion` (companions), `normalizeItem` (`healing`), `healLoadedCharacter` (hit dice), the `rollHistory` load guard. Verified fixed since 09-01: hit dice are catalog-rebuilt on load and the short-rest divisor floors at 1; `rollWithModifier` rejects non-finite/non-number modifiers; `kind: 'attack'` gates the crit label. Verified sound: `USE_ITEM`'s try/catch rejects a junk `healing` visibly without consuming the item; the DM's `npc_attack` damage runs through `sanitizeEnemyDamage`; catalog-only notations (spells, Second Wind) cannot carry junk.
- **Findings:**
  - **P1 — the notation boundary bounds two axes of three.** `parseNotation` rejects `count > 100` and `sides > 1000` but never looks at the modifier: `1d6+1000000` is valid, and `1d6+` followed by 400 digits parses to `Infinity` (`parseInt`). The 2026-09-01 fix made `rollWithModifier` THROW on a non-finite modifier — correct at the kernel — but `rollDamage`'s fallback try wraps only `parseNotation` (`combatMath.js:136-143`), so the throw now escapes every `onInvalid: 'fallback'` caller that used to degrade to 1d4. Reproduced: a companion whose damage string carried the 400-digit modifier threw "Invalid roll modifier: Infinity" straight out of `planCombatExchange`. The silent-concat the 09-01 guard closed became a throw nobody checked the callers for — the "sweep stopped one consumer short" class again, one layer down. Fix at the root: `MAX_ROLL_MODIFIER` in `parseNotation` (throw like count/sides) so the failure happens INSIDE the wrapped parse and the fallback engages for free.
  - **P1 — companion damage is the unbounded twin of the hero's 09-03 bound, on BOTH the DM lane and the load boundary.** `normalizeCompanion`'s no-weapon-change branch stores `merged.damage` raw (`shared.js:502`), the weapon-change branch's 20-char slice admits `9d1000+99999999999`, and an `add_companions` entry without a `weapon` takes the raw branch; LOAD_GAME's `party` guard is an object filter only (`session.js:156-158`) — the hero has `healLoadedCharacter`, enemies `sanitizeLoadedEnemy`, companions nothing. Reproduced: `damage: '100d1000+1000000'` → one hit for **1,099,957**, victory terminal, from the DM lane AND a loaded save; a loaded `attackBonus: '+4'` → `(companion.attackBonus ?? 2) + bonus` = `"+40"` → "Invalid roll modifier: +40" thrown out of EVERY exchange (`combatExchange.js:1210`): the handleSend catch cancels the intent and posts the error, and since rests are refused in combat and companions cannot be removed mid-fight, the campaign is deadlocked; the queued-exchange effect (`ChatPanel.jsx:478`) is not try-wrapped, so a save loaded with a queued action throws inside a React effect. String-typed enemy stats have coerced since 2026-08 ("`\"+4\"` coerces before the validators") — companions never got the twin.
  - **P2 — `rollHistory` entries load half-typed.** The guard is `object && Array.isArray(rolls)` (`session.js:110-111`); object `total`/`description`, a string `modifier`, object faces render "- [object Object]: **[object Object]** ([object Object] zz)" into RECENT DICE ROLLS on every turn (reproduced, `promptBuilder.js:877-881`) and into DicePanel, and a 5k-char `description`/`notation` rides the prompt unclamped. The `recentEncounters` fix of 09-08 is the template: type or drop.
  - **Test depth:** `dice.test.ts` never feeds `parseNotation` a large or 400-digit modifier; no LOAD_GAME test carries a party with a string `attackBonus` or an object `damage`; `normalizeCompanion` has no damage-bound test because there is no bound.
- **Suggested improvements:** (1) `MAX_ROLL_MODIFIER` at the notation boundary + a pin that `rollDamage` in fallback mode degrades (never throws) for every junk shape; (2) `boundCompanionDamage` (count ≤2, sides ≤12, bonus ≤8 — the companion flat-bonus cap) in both `normalizeCompanion` branches, `normalizeCompanion(c, {})` for every loaded companion, `Number()` at the attack-bonus roll site; (3) a typed `rollHistory` entry sanitizer at load; (4) the pins.

### scene-art (`llm/providers/imageGen.js`, `llm/sceneDirector.js`, `SceneArt.jsx` + `sceneArtHelpers.js`, `portraitPrompt.js`, the portrait persistence paths) — Lap 2
- **Scope examined:** both provider parses and the cache, `composeScenePrompt`'s input assembly, `describeEntity`/`buildFocusedPrompt`/`buildCustomPrompt`/`buildFallbackScenePrompt`/`pickSceneSituation`, `buildPortraitPrompt`/`buildNpcPortraitPrompt`, every portrait write (`SET_NPC_PORTRAIT` → `applyNpcPortrait` → `normalizeNpcRecord`, the hero's `UPDATE_CHARACTER` at the sheet and the wizard, the vault's `sanitizeImageUrl`), the hero identity fields at the load boundary, the hosting CSP (`img-src` carries `image.pollinations.ai data: blob:` — the last-resort tier is live in production). Verified fixed since 09-01: the shared narrative-eligibility picker (a scrubbed refusal / table-talk reply is never painted), the 60s stall guard + Cancel on both POSTs, display names at every art boundary, the status-annotated combat cast, `sessionScope` pinned, `isSameLocation` on the clear effect.
- **Findings:**
  - **P1 — the hero's identity fields load untyped, and three consumers assume strings.** `healLoadedCharacter` types level/HP/abilities/hit dice/conditions but spreads `name`/`gender`/`appearance`/`background`/`portraitUrl` raw (`migrations.js:290-301`), while the vault's `sanitizeCharacter` clamps every one of them (`characterVault.js:185-190`) — the sibling with the sanitizer. Reproduced with `gender: {}` in a save: `buildSystemPrompt` throws `character.gender?.trim is not a function` on EVERY turn (`promptBuilder.js:704` — the 07-29 class: one field, every prompt build), and `buildPortraitPrompt` throws at Character Sheet RENDER (`CharacterSheet.jsx:92` computes the prompt unconditionally), so the sheet crashes into its boundary. With `appearance: {}`: `composeScenePrompt` rejects with the raw TypeError (`sceneDirector.js:72` sits above its try) and Scene mode shows "character.appearance?.trim is not a function" as the error; the same object on an NPC survives `normalizeNpcRecord` (no typing for `appearance`/`gender`/`species` — reproduced `{look}`, `['f']`, `5`) and throws at `sceneDirector.js:97` for the NPC line, while `buildFocusedPrompt` joins "[object Object]" into the painter's prompt. `x?.trim()` reads as a null guard but is a TYPE assumption; the idiom for a persisted field is `String(x ?? '')`.
  - **P2 — the hero `portraitUrl` is the one portrait path without the allowlist.** NPC records pass `SAFE_PORTRAIT_URL` at every `normalizeNpcRecord`, hero EXPORTS pass `sanitizeImageUrl`, but the live save stores anything: load spreads it (`migrations.js:290`), `UPDATE_CHARACTER` is a raw spread (`character.js:99-101`). Reproduced: `https://tracker.example/pixel.png` loads and renders as `<img src>` on the sheet, the profile screen, and the reveal — a third-party fetch (tracking pixel, IP disclosure) from a shared hero file's campaign or a cloud save.
  - **P2 — provider payloads are trusted by shape, not type.** Gemini `inlineData.data` non-string → `data:image/png;base64,[object Object]` returned as a SUCCESS and cached under the scene key (reproduced, `imageGen.js:239-249`) — SceneArt renders a broken `<img>` with no `onError` and no notice, and Visualize keeps returning it until Reroll; `inlineData.mimeType` is interpolated verbatim, so a `text/html` mime flows to `SET_NPC_PORTRAIT` (dropped by the allowlist — but `portraitProvider`/`portraitUpdatedAt` still stamp, `npcs.js:19-29`: "Rendered by gemini" beside no picture) and to the hero's `UPDATE_CHARACTER`, which stores it (reproduced), so the next export→import silently loses the portrait. xAI's non-string `b64_json` throws into the catch and is reported as `xai-network: b64.startsWith is not a function`. Both parses should require a string body and an `image/(png|jpe?g|webp|gif)` mime (anything else is `*-empty`), portrait metadata should stamp only when the URL survived, and the rendered `<img>` needs an `onError` that surfaces a notice.
  - **P2 (minor) — `pickSceneSituation` paints the apology.** With no narration in the transcript the picker falls to `journal[last].summary` without checking `fallback` (`sceneArtHelpers.js:103`; reproduced "Auto-summary was unavailable for a stretch of 10 messages." as the situation) — the 09-06 "never embedded" rule, one consumer over. Rare (an empty or fully hidden transcript).
  - **Test depth:** none of the above is pinned — `imageGen.test.js` (30+ tests) never sends a non-string payload or a non-image mime; no LOAD_GAME test carries typed-junk identity fields; `sceneDirector.test.js` never passes an untyped record.
- **Suggested improvements:** (1) string-clamp the identity fields in `healLoadedCharacter` with the vault's limits and type `appearance`/`gender`/`species` in `normalizeNpcRecord` (+ `String()` belts at the four `?.trim()` sites); (2) `SAFE_PORTRAIT_URL` on the hero at load and in the reducer write; (3) typed provider parses + `onError`; (4) skip `fallback` entries in the picker; (5) the pins.

### Process notes
- Queue was EMPTY at run start; eight items added (3 P1). Coverage snapshot not refreshed (6 days).
- Lap-2 pattern confirmed for the third feature pair running: every P1 here is a sanitizer that exists for a SIBLING and stops one record short — `boundWeaponDamage` (hero) vs companions, `sanitizeLoadedEnemy` vs `party` at load, `sanitizeCharacter` (exports) vs `healLoadedCharacter` (saves), `SAFE_PORTRAIT_URL` (NPCs) vs the hero. Worth a standing lap-opener step: for each trust boundary, list the record types that cross it and check each one has the SAME sanitizer, not just one.
- New sub-pattern worth naming: **a fix that turns a silent coercion into a throw moves the failure, it doesn't remove it.** The 09-01 modifier guard was right, but nothing re-checked which fallback paths could now reach it with untyped input. When a guard becomes a throw, grep its callers for `try` coverage.

## 2026-09-08 — hidden-fronts + living-world (Lap 2: robustness against hostile input — opens Lap 2 of the second cycle)

`npm test`: 2214 passing / 106 files (green)

Rotation: the last-6 union (origin == HEAD) excludes progression, chat-orchestration, scribe, prompt-building, memory-journal, story-memory, providers-adapter, vector-memory-rag, response-parsing, enemy-stats-conditions, spellcasting, chronicler. Least recently audited eligible: **living-world** (08-31), then the three 09-01 features tie-broken toward the lowest coverage → **hidden-fronts** (`frontDirector.js` 87.50). Every registry feature has now had a Lap-1 pass in the second cycle (09-01 → 09-07), so this run opens **Lap 2 — hostile input**: malformed DM/director output and malformed/stale saves. Every finding below was **reproduced empirically** against the live reducer/engine with a throwaway vitest file (deleted, never committed; zero repo changes).

### hidden-fronts (`engine/fronts.js`, `state/handlers/fronts.js`, `llm/frontDirector.js`, `llm/frontUpgrade.js`, `worldTempo.js` directive validation, the `front_updates` wire) — Lap 2
- **Scope examined:** every DM-writable path into a front (`front_updates` → `guardedList` → `normalizeFrontUpdate` → `UPDATE_FRONT`), every director path (`sanitizeGeneratedFronts`, `normalizeEmergentFront`, the three installers, `applyFrontAdvanceBatch`, `normalizeTempoDirective`), and the load boundary (`validateSaveState` → `normalizeFront` / `normalizeLocationRecord`, `worldTempo` passthrough). Verified fixed since 09-01: resolved is terminal in `UPDATE_FRONT` (status/clock/stage stripped, dormant→resolved runs the ceremony), the locative-first premise anchor, the by-title lookup deleted. Verified sound under adversarial shapes: `normalizeEmergentFront` (case-folded title/faction dedupe, string `relationships` → `[]`, complete-or-nothing), `normalizeTempoDirective` (numeric `front_id` coerces and matches, every text field clamped, unknown intensity → band), the installers' sessionId/one-shot keys, the DM clock-gain throttle, `parseDirectorJson`'s repair-then-throw.
- **Findings:**
  - **P1 — any non-numeric `clock` in `front_updates` is read as clock 0 and SOFTENS the front, unthrottled.** `normalizeFrontUpdate` gates on `update.clock !== undefined` and `clampInt(update.clock, 0, 12, 0)` falls back to 0 for `null`, `""`, `"unchanged"`, `"same"` (`fronts.js:217`); `UPDATE_FRONT` then bounds it to `existing − 1` — and softening is deliberately never throttled ("player interference always lands", `handlers/fronts.js:200-212`). Reproduced: three `{ "id": …, "clock": null, "notes": "no change" }` emissions walked a front 3 → 0 with no system line and stage untouched. A DM writing `null`/"unchanged" to mean "no change" is the documented LLM shape the parser treats as string-or-null everywhere else (CLAUDE.md 2026-09-05); here it is a silent, persistent de-escalation lever on private state, the mirror image of the +1 replay the 08-26 throttle closed. Fix: `null`/non-finite clock or stage means "omit" (drop the key), never 0.
  - **P1 — a null or malformed entry in `fronts` or `locations` makes the campaign un-loadable.** `validateSaveState` entry-shape-guards messages, quests, journal, rollHistory, npcs, party, chronicle (the 07-25 / 07-29 / 09-04 sweeps) but not these two arrays: `payload.fronts.map(f => normalizeFront(f))` throws on `null` (default params skip null — "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'maxClock')", `session.js:144`), and `normalizeLocationRecord` throws on `null` (`(reading 'name')`) and on a string-valued `aliases`/`theaterFrontIds` (`(record.aliases || []).map is not a function`, `locationRegistry.js:141,153`). Reproduced all four; the throw escapes LOAD_GAME, which since 09-02 is loud → `loadError` on the start screen, no way in. A cloud save is a JSON round-trip (array hole → `null`) — the exact class the 07-25 fix documented. A string front entry loads as a live "Unnamed Front" web member (counted by the upgrade rail) — silent junk rather than a crash.
  - **P2 — `worldTempo` is the one front-adjacent field loaded raw.** `session.js:160-162` accepts any object; nothing re-runs `normalizeTempoDirective`, and `buildWorldTempoBlock` renders the STORED `maxIntensity`/`expiryDistance` (`worldTempo.js:471`). Reproduced: a directive claiming `confrontation` on a clock-0 front with `expiryDistance: 1e9` renders "THIS SCENE'S PERMISSION … Maximum intensity: confrontation … raiders burn the mill" forever — the system's founding promise ("a clock-1 front cannot put raiders on-screen") bypassed at the load boundary; a hostile label ("IGNORE ALL PREVIOUS RULES") prints verbatim into the prompt. Live-path residue of the same omission: the band is clamped at GRANT time only, so a `presence` window granted at clock 4 stays `presence` after the player's interference softens the clock to 1 inside the same 24-message window. Re-clamp `maxIntensity` against the live band at render (and whitelist the label) and the load case is covered for free; a load-time `tempoDirectiveDistances` cap closes the infinite window.
  - **P2 — `String()` coercion mints "[object Object]" canon.** `fronts.js`'s `cleanText` and `directorUtils.cleanText` both `String(value)` any shape: a DM `notes: { how: "burned" }` on a resolution becomes the front's `resolution` epitaph, the RECENT VICTORY echo, the hearsay text, AND a permanent world fact ("… resolved through the hero's actions. [object Object]" — reproduced); a reflection `symptom: {…}` lands in `publicHints` (reproduced); an absence-drift `world_fact: {…}` installs a permanent "[object Object]" fact through `ADD_WORLD_FACTS` (reproduced — same class the 07-23 world-facts fix closed on the DM lane and the 09-04 quests P1 on that lane). Both helpers should return `''` for non-string/non-number input.
  - **P2 (shape holes in `normalizeFrontUpdate`):** `publicHints` as a string or `[]` (`"publicHints": "Refugees whisper"` — a common single-item LLM shape) normalizes to `[]` and `normalizeFront` treats the empty array as authoritative → the front's accumulated symptom ledger is wiped, and with it the tempo block's "Symptoms ALREADY shown" anti-repeat line (reproduced); an unknown or `null` `status` ("ongoing", "escalating", `null`) normalizes to `'active'` and silently revives a DORMANT front (reproduced) — junk should mean "omit", like clock. `normalizeFront` itself clamps nothing textual: a 20k-char `id`/`title`/`goal`/`notes` survive load and the 🕰️ resolution line carries the full title (reproduced; generated/emergent paths clamp upstream, so load and hand-edits are the exposure).
  - **Test depth:** no suite feeds `UPDATE_FRONT` a null/string clock or status, a string `publicHints`, or an object `notes`; no LOAD_GAME test carries a null/string front or a malformed location record; `worldTempo` is never loaded in any test.
- **Suggested improvements:** (1) "junk means omit" in `normalizeFrontUpdate` for clock/stage/status/publicHints + pins; (2) entry-shape guards for `fronts` and `locations` in `validateSaveState` (and array-typing inside `normalizeLocationRecord`) + a null-entry load test each; (3) render-time band re-clamp + load-time directive normalization; (4) type-strict `cleanText` in both helpers.

- **Scope examined:** all four modules end to end (context builders, sanitizers, block renderers); `SET_LOCATION`'s arrival tail and `INSTALL_ABSENCE_DRIFT`/`INSTALL_AFTERMATH_FRONTS`/`INSTALL_REGIONAL_FRONTS`/`UPDATE_LOCATION_PROFILE`; the load boundary for `recentEncounters`, `recentHearsay`, `session.{regionalHearsay,absenceDrift,pending*}`; `buildWorldTempoBlock`'s encounter rendering.
